name: Question 16
problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x+4y-6z=4 \\ 6x+12y-18z=12 \\ -10x-20y+30z=-20\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & -6 & 4 \\ 6 & 12 & -18 & 12 \\ -10 & -20 & 30 & -20\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 & -6 & 4 \\ 6 & 12 & -18 & 12 \\ -10 & -20 & 30 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 6 & 12 & -18 & 12 \\ -10 & -20 & 30 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-6){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -10 & -20 & 30 & -20\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+10{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
